# 你好，我是熠辉 / Yihui 👋

**独立开发者与全栈工程师，专注构建实用的 AI 产品、创作工具与可复用的 Agent Skills。**

[English](./README.md) · [个人网站](https://happyaicoding.com/) · [X](https://x.com/yihui_indie) · [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@yihui_indie) · [哔哩哔哩](https://space.bilibili.com/39930228)

我有 10 年 Web 开发经验。目前主要在 AI、视频创作和 Coding Agent 的交叉地带工作。我通常从一个真实工作流出发，把它做成可用产品，再将其中真正有效的部分沉淀为可复用的工具、Skills 与文档。

---

## 我在做什么

- 🧩 **Agent Skills** — 面向编程、内容和视频生产的可重复工作流。
- 🎬 **AI 创作工具** — 把想法和脚本转成可继续编辑、可控的素材与流程。
- 🛠️ **开发者教育** — 从真实开发与上线过程出发的项目式教程。

## 产品与实验

- 🎞️ **[MkBoard](https://mkboard.app/)** — 桌面端分镜 Agent，把脚本转成可编辑的镜头规划与生成式 B-roll 素材。
- ✨ **[MkAnime](https://mkanime.ai/)** — 一站式 AI 动漫生产平台，覆盖剧本、分镜、角色、配音与导出。
- 🧑‍💻 **[熠辉 AI 编程课](https://happyaicoding.com/)** — 从真实项目出发，帮助学习者把想法做成可用产品的 AI 编程实战课程。

## 公开项目

- 👕 **[codebuddy-aifit-demo](https://github.com/yihui-dev/codebuddy-aifit-demo)** — 使用 TDesign 与腾讯云开发搭建的 AI 智能试衣微信小程序演示。
- 🧱 **[vuepress-element-doc](https://github.com/yihui-dev/vuepress-element-doc)** — 使用 VuePress 搭建组件库文档的示例项目。

### 更早的开发教程

- 🧪 **[Vue-Testing-Demo](https://github.com/yihui-dev/Vue-Testing-Demo)** — 使用 Mocha、Karma、Vue Test Utils 与 Chai 的 Vue 单元测试实战示例。
- 🗃️ **[Vuex-Demo](https://github.com/yihui-dev/Vuex-Demo)** — 逐步讲解 Vuex state、getters、mutations、actions 与 modules 的教程。

## 我的工作方式

我重视清晰的边界、可编辑的产物、可复现的流程，以及能让下一位开发者在 Demo 之后继续维护项目的文档。

如果你也在构建实用的 Agent Skills 或 AI-native 创作工具，欢迎交流，或在对应仓库中发起 Issue。

# Hi, I'm Yihui / 熠辉 👋

**Independent developer and full-stack engineer building practical AI products, creative tools, and reusable Agent Skills.**

[中文](./README.zh-CN.md) · [Website](https://happyaicoding.com/) · [X](https://x.com/yihui_indie) · [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@yihui_indie) · [Bilibili](https://space.bilibili.com/39930228)

I've spent 10 years building for the web. Today I work at the intersection of AI, video creation, and coding agents. I usually start with a real workflow, ship it as a product, then turn what works into reusable tools, Skills, and documentation.

---

## What I build

- 🧩 **Agent Skills** — Repeatable workflows for coding, content, and video production.
- 🎬 **AI creative tools** — Controllable systems that turn ideas and scripts into editable assets.
- 🛠️ **Developer education** — Project-based tutorials drawn from real implementation and shipping work.

## Products & experiments

- 🎞️ **[MkBoard](https://mkboard.app/)** — A desktop storyboard agent that turns scripts into editable shot plans and generated B-roll assets.
- ✨ **[MkAnime](https://mkanime.ai/)** — An all-in-one AI anime studio for scripts, storyboards, characters, dubbing, and export.
- 🧑‍💻 **[Happy AI Coding](https://happyaicoding.com/)** — Practical, project-based AI coding courses for people who want to turn ideas into working products.

## Public projects

- 👕 **[codebuddy-aifit-demo](https://github.com/yihui-dev/codebuddy-aifit-demo)** — An AI virtual try-on WeChat Mini Program demo built with TDesign and Tencent CloudBase.
- 🧱 **[vuepress-element-doc](https://github.com/yihui-dev/vuepress-element-doc)** — A VuePress example for building component-library documentation.

### Earlier developer tutorials

- 🧪 **[Vue-Testing-Demo](https://github.com/yihui-dev/Vue-Testing-Demo)** — A hands-on Vue unit-testing example using Mocha, Karma, Vue Test Utils, and Chai.
- 🗃️ **[Vuex-Demo](https://github.com/yihui-dev/Vuex-Demo)** — A step-by-step guide to Vuex state, getters, mutations, actions, and modules.

## How I work

I care about clear boundaries, editable outputs, reproducible workflows, and documentation that helps the next developer maintain a project after the first demo.

If you are building practical Agent Skills or AI-native creative tools, feel free to say hi or open an issue in the relevant repository.
